run_preprocess_pipeline: run the preprocessing pipeline to tokenize and binarize code datasets for XLM pretraining
create_XLM_symlinks: create symlinks for XLM pretraining from processed language code files
test_preprocess_cli: test the preprocess CLI module with two languages and local execution
refactor_preprocess: refactor the preprocess function to support three languages with configurable BPE training size
summarize_check_files: summarize the check_files_and_symlink_for_XLM function that validates and creates XLM symlinks
